# Security Policy / 安全性政策

## Reporting a vulnerability / 回報弱點

Tapo NVR handles camera footage and passwords, so please **do not report security problems in public issues**.

Tapo NVR 會處理攝影機畫面與密碼，因此**請勿在公開的 Issue 回報安全性問題**。

Please use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
請使用 GitHub 的私密弱點回報：

👉 <https://github.com/fengnaiouo/Tapo-NVR/security/advisories/new>

Please include / 請附上：

- Affected version / 受影響的版本
- Steps to reproduce / 重現步驟
- Impact (what an attacker could do) / 影響範圍（攻擊者能做什麼）

We aim to reply within 7 days and will credit you in the release notes unless you prefer otherwise.
我們會盡量在 7 天內回覆，並在發布說明中致謝（如不希望具名請告知）。

## Supported versions / 支援的版本

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/fengnaiouo/Tapo-NVR/releases/latest) receives security fixes. The desktop app updates itself automatically.

只有[最新版本](https://github.com/fengnaiouo/Tapo-NVR/releases/latest)會收到安全性修正，桌面版會自動更新。
